The '''Gratz Foundry''' was a foundry situated within the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Boneyard (Nox)|Boneyard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nox (planet)|Nox]] that was operated by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] forge master [[Gratz]]. In [[25,793 BBY]], the [[darksider]]s [[Daegen Lok]] and [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] made their way to the Gratz Foundry while on the run from the [[Je'daii Order]], and Xesh utilized the forge's facilities to construct two [[Forcesaber]] weapons.
